name: Citizenship by Naturalisation

requirements.blocker_text: 15 years of continuous residence in Chad.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 15 years of continuous residence in Chad.

requirements.blocker_text: Fluency in French or another language used in Chad.

Good mental/physical health and no criminal convictions; the 1963 implementing decree additionally requires freedom from tuberculosis, alcoholism, and venereal disease, and an inquiry into morality and loyalty ('moralité et le loyalisme').
Documented adaptation to Chadian customs and practices ('moeurs, usages et coutumes du Tchad'), per the 1963 implementing decree.

sources.title: Wikipedia -- Chadian nationality law: naturalisation requires 15 years' continuous residence, French/local-language fluency, good health, no criminal convictions; grant is by presidential decree

Refworld (UNHCR) -- Décret n°211/PG.-INT. du 6 novembre 1963 (implementing decree of Chad's 1962 Nationality Code): naturalisation granted by presidential decree, subject to a morality/loyalty inquiry, health screening, and demonstrated assimilation to Chadian customs; a 1-year period is referenced at Article 21 without full context in the fetched excerpt

The decree itself references a much shorter 'one-year period' at Article 21 in the fetched excerpt, which may govern a different procedural step (e.g. minimum residence before an application can be FILED, versus the total residence threshold to QUALIFY) rather than contradicting the 15-year figure -- this ambiguity is disclosed rather than resolved by picking one number arbitrarily. If Chad's naturalisation threshold is genuinely lower than the 15 years modeled here, this file overstates the requirement; flagged as a priority re-verification target. Grant is by presidential decree, not an administrative/automatic process -- selection_method 'assessed' understates the discretionary, individually-decreed nature of the final step, disclosed here since the schema has no more precise category for a head-of-state discretionary grant.
